mission: Run Ralph iterations that simplify Kuzushi with Clean Code discipline while preserving behavior.
nonGoals: No model/runtime fallback or enforcement changes.
No feature work disguised as refactoring.
globalInvariants: Every iteration starts from a clean working tree.
Each story changes exactly one coherent simplification slice.
The Rust Ratatui shell remains the operator TUI surface.
Scan, shell, and run mode contracts remain compatible.
ModuleTool, DagTool, ExecutionContext, and host handle contracts remain source-compatible.
Comments explain non-obvious why; they do not narrate the refactor.

stories.title: Record Current Simplification Hotspots
stories.why: The loop needs current Rust-first hotspot data instead of stale TS/Ink cleanup reports.
acceptance: A current hotspot assessment exists.
The PRD encodes refactor-only constraints and story gates.
The loop script can select incomplete stories and generate a prompt.
stories.commitMessage: chore: add uncle bob simplification loop

stories.title: Decompose Core Module Registry Families
stories.why: `crates/kuzushi-core/src/modules.rs` is the largest file in the repo and mixes registry plumbing, SAST, taint, artifact writing, and module-specific helpers.
acceptance: At least one cohesive module family is extracted from modules.rs.
Public registry behavior and tool names remain unchanged.
No module contract or persisted artifact shape changes.
The extracted code has intention-revealing module/file names.
stories.storyGate: cargo check -p kuzushi-core && cargo test -p kuzushi-core modules

stories.title: Extract Rust TUI App State Transitions
stories.why: `crates/kuzushi-tui/src/app.rs` is over 10k lines and combines state definitions, command handling, workers, parsing helpers, and tests.
acceptance: One cohesive reducer/helper group moves out of app.rs.
Shell state transitions remain covered by existing tests.
No command parser/help/footer drift is introduced.
Plain and TUI output behavior is unchanged.
stories.commitMessage: refactor: simplify rust tui app state

stories.title: Extract Rust TUI Rendering Surfaces
stories.why: `crates/kuzushi-tui/src/renderer.rs` mixes strict plain rendering, view-line builders, layout widgets, and formatting helpers.
acceptance: One cohesive rendering surface moves out of renderer.rs.
Strict plain output remains no ANSI, no box drawing, and width-safe.
Ratatui rendering tests remain deterministic.
Shared formatting helpers are named by intent.

stories.title: Separate Verification Pipeline Phases
stories.why: `crates/kuzushi-core/src/verify.rs` is large enough that planning, classification, evidence handling, and persistence are difficult to review together.
acceptance: One verification phase is extracted behind a narrow helper/module boundary.
Verification output shapes and verdict semantics remain unchanged.
Evidence merge behavior remains covered by existing tests.
No runtime/model fallback behavior changes.
stories.storyGate: cargo check -p kuzushi-core && cargo test -p kuzushi-core verify

stories.title: Separate Finding Persistence And Reporting Helpers
stories.why: `crates/kuzushi-core/src/findings.rs` concentrates persistence, query, deduplication, and reporting helpers.
acceptance: One cohesive findings helper group is extracted.
Finding fingerprints, aliases, and serialized fields remain stable.
Database and report behavior remain covered by existing tests.
No compatibility path for existing .kuzushi stores is removed.
stories.storyGate: cargo check -p kuzushi-core && cargo test -p kuzushi-core findings

stories.title: Simplify Secondary Rust Hotspots
stories.why: `scan.rs`, `systems_hunt.rs`, and `variant_ndiff.rs` remain large after the primary surfaces and should be simplified in smaller targeted slices.
acceptance: Exactly one secondary hotspot gets one focused simplification slice.
Scan artifact output and systems-hunt result semantics remain unchanged.
No broad rewrite across all three files in a single iteration.
The story progress entry names the exact hotspot touched.
stories.storyGate: cargo check -p kuzushi-core && cargo test -p kuzushi-core

stories.title: Run Full Simplification Milestone Gate
stories.why: After the focused refactors, the repo needs a full integration check and cleanup note.
acceptance: Full workspace tests/builds run or any blocker is recorded with exact command output.
Progress summarizes remaining simplification opportunities.
No code edits are made unless fixing a regression introduced by the simplification loop.
stories.commitMessage: chore: record uncle bob simplification milestone
